notes.title: Major Update – Rotting Marshes
notes.content:
Major Update – Rotting Marshes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640445/cf0f1b7d1b42732bed99c89290297545bb1e7d19.png"]
Greetings, Undead Wanderers!
We are excited to announce a major content update for our game. The long-awaited Rotting Marshes expansion is finally here, bringing new dangers, rewards, and experiences.
[hr][/hr]New Location: Rotting Marshes
Explore the cursed swamps filled with deadly traps, hidden treasures, and dark secrets.

Encounter new bosses that guard the heart of the marshlands.

Discover unique interactions and adult-themed scenes hidden within the foggy depths.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640445/97a716598c7587191eb6c481adc3eba7c1b966b2.png"]
[hr][/hr]New Equipment: Helmets
A new armor type has been added — helmets.

Scattered throughout the world, they provide extra protection and style.

Each helmet comes with its own lore and design, fitting seamlessly into the world.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640445/5dec7d7c1f4f6f8c0e5b008d9243dc46f9429171.png"]
[hr][/hr]New Weapons & Shields
Face the horrors of the marshes with a selection of new swords and shields.

Designed for both survival and style, these weapons will be your key to victory.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640445/4c8b12dc170f65c5e042641f111cf0c126d597d8.png"]
[hr][/hr]New Adult Scenes
Several new erotic scenes have been added for those who dare to uncover them.

Hidden throughout the game world — find them if you dare.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640445/fcd9c2f408ed739110fc336038adb56d1b156c00.png"]
[hr][/hr]New Steam Achievements
Unlock brand new achievements connected to the Rotting Marshes.

Challenge yourself and prove your skill by conquering the swamp and its secrets.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes & Improvements
We’ve also polished many aspects of the game for a smoother experience:

Fixed shield impact sounds.

Adjusted ambient sounds in certain locations.

Corrected item descriptions.

Improved lighting in multiple areas.

Rebalanced parts of the game for better pacing and challenge.
[hr][/hr]Performance Optimizations
General performance improvements across multiple systems.

Reduced stuttering and improved stability in larger areas.

Optimized assets and lighting for smoother gameplay, even in the heaviest zones.

This is one of our biggest updates yet — dive into the Rotting Marshes and see if you can survive what lurks within.

notes.content:

Stay tuned — the update is coming soon!

notes.title: Patch Notes 27.08
notes.content:
- Added a new Settings menu in the main menu.

- You can now adjust the volume (affecting all sounds except sex scenes) and switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.

- Item descriptions have been updated to be more readable.

- Fixed an issue where the game could sometimes crash unexpectedly.

notes.title: Hotfix Update – August 24, 2025
notes.content:
This hotfix brings several important improvements and balance changes:

- Shortcuts now save and work properly – no more losing progress when reloading.

- Reduced visual effects on some weapons – so they won’t block your view in combat.

- Boss highlighting added – certain bosses are now easier to see from a distance.

- Speed per level-up increased – from +0.3% to +0.4% per upgrade.

- Graphics quality boosted by ~5% – enjoy a slightly sharper and more polished look.

notes.title: Hotfix Update – August 23, 2025
notes.content:
We’ve just rolled out a hotfix to improve gameplay and fix some issues:

- More responsive attacks – combat feels smoother. Some rare bugs may still occur, but they’ll be fully resolved soon.

- Shield usage no longer drains stamina – defend without worrying about stamina.

- Jump animations 50% faster – movement in the air feels more fluid.

- First boss clone ability removed – players will no longer get stuck in clones.

Thanks for your feedback and patience! Keep enjoying the game, and stay tuned for more updates.
